activities.title: Type the Office Supplies Inventory
activities.intro: Open Excel, Google Sheets or LibreOffice Calc and type the inventory from the slide. This file becomes your Lab 3 output, so save it carefully.

items: Open a new blank workbook and click A1.
Type the 6 headers across row 1, pressing Tab after each: Item, Unit, Qty, Unit Cost, Total Cost, Reorder Level.
Type rows 2 to 9 exactly as shown on the slide. Leave column E (Total Cost) empty.
Type unit costs as plain numbers: 245, not ₱245.
Double-click the sheet tab and rename it Inventory.
Save the file as Lab3 Inventory - YourName.

blocks.prompt: Click the cell that says Fastener. What does the Name Box show?
Click the Qty of Printer ink, black. What does the Name Box show?
What is the name of your worksheet tab now?
Optional: a screenshot of your typed inventory

help: A number sits on the left of its cell? It was typed as text. Click it and type the plain number again.
Typed over a cell by mistake? Press Ctrl+Z to undo.
To fix part of a cell, press F2 or double-click the cell.

blocks.prompt: You're in cell F9 at the bottom of the inventory. What takes you straight to A1?
